# Bank Statement Scanner

> AI-powered tool that turns bank, credit card, and PDF statements into clean, categorized transaction data you can export to CSV or Excel. Upload a statement (digital or scanned), extract itemized transactions with dates, descriptions, and amounts, apply smart categorization, and export in seconds.

## Pages

- [Home](https://bankstatementscanner.com/): Product overview, features, pricing, and FAQ.
- [Scanner](https://bankstatementscanner.com/scanner): The app — upload a statement PDF and export structured data.
- [Blog](https://bankstatementscanner.com/blog): Guides on statement extraction, CSV/Excel export, and bookkeeping workflows.
- [Security](https://bankstatementscanner.com/security): How financial data is protected — encryption, incognito processing, retention controls, Stripe payments.
- [Contact](https://bankstatementscanner.com/contact): Support and general enquiries.
